content: .{@-आख्यपञ्चमूलम्@} the pentad of medicinal roots: Turmeric root; a species of Moon-seed (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>गुळवेल</ns>); Dolichandrone Falcata (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>मेढशिंगी</ns>); Hemidesmus indicus (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>उपळसरी</ns>); and विदारीकंद (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>भुईकोहळा</ns>).
